sources: https://www.camplife.com/382/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API: reservation session and site records for campground 382, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system (a free account is needed, and availability shows only once logged in). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period. Up to 8 people per site.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/econfina-creek/white-oak-landing/ ('Three camping sites are available by reservation only. Each site can hold a maximum of eight people per site.', 'Reserve' link to camplife.com/382) + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights. No more than two (2) reservations can be booked at a time or in a 30 day period'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/econfina-creek/white-oak-landing/ ('Though RV camping is permitted, no power, water, or waste disposal hookups are available.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Three back-in sites taking motorhomes, travel trailers, fifth wheels, vans, fold-downs and tents. CampLife lists every site as 50 ft, which looks like a default rather than a measured length, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/econfina-creek/white-oak-landing/ ('Three camping sites') + CampLife session for campground 382 (Sites 1-3 'Back-in', equipment MOTORHOME, TRAVEL TRAILER, 5TH WHEEL, VAN, FOLDDOWN, TENT), read 2026-10-21

note: Northwest Florida Water Management District landing at the south end of Porter Lake in the Econfina Creek WMA, about 23 miles south of Chipley (4909 Porter Pond Road). Pavilion, picnic tables, pedestal grills, fire rings, portable toilet, small boat launch. Site length is not published - primitive sites on unpaved access; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page and its CampLife records: 3 reservation-only back-in RV/tent sites, no hookups, 7-night limit, free. No storm-closure banner on the page and not on the District's closures list (2026-10-21). Note trimmed of the count/hookup/booking facts the fields carry. Not stated: real max rig length, season, potable water.
flags: Availability on CampLife is shown only to a logged-in (free) account; camping is free, so no rate is hidden.
